content.comment_body: Hello, Where did you find the swimming pool sample project? I haven’t found any link on the [company_name] website. Thanks for your help.
You’ll find it in the download area of the [product_name] Web Editor. The download for the [product_name] Web Editor is available together with the complete [product_name] Soft Comfort package.
Thanks for your quick response. I have downloaded the package, but I don’t see any file for the pool project.
I also have the SP1 version, but I cannot locate the pool project sample file.
Within the download for the LWE software, there are three folders: Help, Installer, and Sample. Check the Sample folder for the LWE project and LSC file.
The LWE software download contains three folders: Help, Installer, and Sample. You can find the project and LSC file in the Sample folder.
Sorry, but I think there’s some confusion. When I download 'LOGO_V8_2_SP1_complete.zip', there’s no sample file included. Has something changed?

The complete package contains the [product_name] Web Editor. If you unzip all the files, there’s a folder called 'LOGO V8_2 SP1 complete,' which has two main subfolders: one for firmware updates and another for upgrades. Within the upgrade folder, you’ll find separate directories for installers, including one specifically for LWE. The LWE installer folder contains multiple subfolders. This structure can be confusing, so it might be easier if I upload the sample project directly for you.

Sorry for all the confusion. Under Windows, I see only two executable files, as shown in the screenshot. Thanks for providing the link—I downloaded it, and it seems to work fine now. Appreciate your patience.
Yes, you’ll need to start one of those executable files.
I started the 64-bit executable and the program installed, but I still don’t see any sample files. I’m new to [product_name], so this seems a bit unusual.

Finding specific sample projects on the [company_name] website can be challenging, especially if they’re not organized well. I wasn’t able to locate the swimming pool sample there either; sometimes users share these on forums or third-party sites dedicated to [company_name] products. If your project is related to pool automation, you might also consult a smart pool specialist who could offer helpful resources.
After more than four years, I believe the original poster is no longer searching for this project.

analysis.insight_summary: Users struggle to locate a specific sample project (swimming pool project) associated with the [product_name] Web Editor and its download package. Even when following detailed instructions about folder structures, users are unable to find the relevant sample files, resulting in confusion and repeated requests for clarification. The organization of the folders and files within the download package is not intuitive, which hampers access and adds to user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect sample projects to be clearly labeled and easily accessible, either within the download package or directly on the [company_name] website. They also seek clear, straightforward instructions for finding and opening these sample files.
